summary.text: Stewart Cathey Jr. is a Republican state senator from the Monroe area and a business owner who served as an Army engineer officer. He lost a 2015 state Senate race, won the District 33 seat in 2019, and now chairs the Senate Agriculture committee. He launched his congressional campaign in July 2026.

paragraphs.text: Cathey was born on April 19, 1981, and graduated from the University of Louisiana at Monroe.
He joined the U.S. Army in 2003 and served as a commissioned officer and Army engineer, deploying a second time in 2016.
He is a lieutenant colonel in the U.S. Army Reserve, and in announcing his candidacy he described himself as a combat veteran.
Since 2013 he has worked as a managing partner at the Cathey Group.
Cathey ran for Louisiana Senate District 35 in 2015 and lost to fellow Republican James Fannin.
He won Louisiana Senate District 33 in 2019, defeating Republican Wade Bishop with 52% of the vote, and took office in January 2020.

His committee assignments for 2025-2026 include chair of the Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development Committee, along with Commerce, Consumer Protection, and International Affairs; Local and Municipal Affairs; and Technology and Cybersecurity.
Cathey announced his run for Louisiana's 5th Congressional District in July 2026 and qualified as a candidate in August 2026.
